# Close wrap, Fri 2026-10-30 (~4:30 PM ET)

1. **Tech rout.** Nasdaq 100 −4%, near correction; S&P 500 about −2 to −2.5%, worst day since June and a third losing week; Dow −1.2% ([Bloomberg via Swissinfo](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/nasdaq-100-sinks-4%25%2C-gets-close-to-correction-zone%3A-markets-wrap/92299351); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-alphabet-oil-16c266731fdf64178f38070af2b42497)). Nasdaq 100 lost >$1.2T in October.
2. **Sectors (late session):** energy +1.6%, staples +1.4%, health care +0.9% led; tech −4.3%, discretionary −0.9%, industrials −0.8% lagged ([24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/cards/us-stocks-are-lower-energy-leads-while-technology-lags-sharply-spy-market-explainer-01m66kskzqbfr8mny5zn7yexnm)).
3. **INTC −28.6% to $65.76**, worst in 40+ years on the Q4 guide ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/INTC?date=2026-10-30&view=daily); [Bloomberg](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/nasdaq-100-sinks-4%25%2C-gets-close-to-correction-zone%3A-markets-wrap/92299351)). **AMZN −1.4% to $240.35**, up from a $229.36 low and a −7% pre-market ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/AMZN?date=2026-10-30&view=daily)); it set up up to $80B in supplier financing for AI hardware.
4. **Energy beats:** XOM +2.2% to $187.26, CVX +1.8% to $235.53 on record refining ([XOM](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/XOM?date=2026-10-30&view=daily); [CVX](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/CVX?date=2026-10-30&view=daily)). ABBV +1.4% to $294.87 ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/ABBV?date=2026-10-30&view=daily)). Oil rose on worries of renewed US strikes on Iran; BTC ~$77k after the Binance hack.
5. **Setup:** ISM Mfg 11/2; AAPL, PLTR 11/2 AMC; AMD 11/3 AMC + midterms + JOLTS; jobs 11/6. Risk is rotation turning into cash if the averages keep sliding (Miller Tabak, per Bloomberg).

## Swing ideas
- **XOM** long, low. Profit beat on record refining, +2.2% close near the $188.50 high in a −2% tape. Risk: oil premium fades on Iran talks.

## Weekly scorecard (10/26–10/30, MTM to 10/30 close, free yfinance data)
17 new calls: 8 up, 8 down, 1 flat; avg +0.14%/call vs SPY −0.95% (10/23→10/30 close). Best UPS +6.6%, PNR +6.4%, LLY +6.4%; worst MU −8.0%, VRT −4.3%, GLW −3.7%, MSFT −3.4%. Beat-and-raises outside tech worked; AI-hardware longs got hit by the capex scare.
